name: design-polish
description: Design reference-based polishing with WCAG accessibility checks. Measurement engine (real styleFit/performance), mobile a11y + touch targets, close-the-loop verification (renewal auto-captures pre-apply baseline), route auto-discovery. v2.5.0: design contract (DESIGN.md + design-decisions.json) with ratcheted token-drift lint, Korean typography rules, component state contract, numbered rule IDs. v2.6.0: keyboard-measured focus audit, contract-hashed token baseline, split penalty caps, 4-level severity, script-computed stagnation/severity rollup, shared fail-closed backup procedure, Unicode-aware BM25 search. v2.7.0: Pivot keys off blockingNewViolations (baseline-frozen debt no longer forces a renewal), per-element :focus-visible matching with unreadable-stylesheet honesty, all-timeout probes are not SERVER_DOWN, TIMEOUT-derived probe timeout, probe-skipped routes no longer fail the run (documented exit codes), stagnation.runs/window disambiguated, exported pure decision functions with 150 unit tests. v2.8.0: readability lint (DP-R001..008) and slop-pattern lint (DP-P001..004), report-only so Health Score and Pivot are unchanged; contract ruleWaivers with declared decision + reason; model-judged craft floor (DP-F: render checks, refuse list, cognitive load, surface modes) with fixed default severities. v2.8.2: craft floor rewritten in the project's own words, so the whole plugin is MIT; THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md carries the ui-ux-pro-max-skill MIT notice for the design data.
